clips.title: The story
paras: Call of Water sends spiritual seekers into the Wetlands to learn the cleansing power of water and seek the water sapta. In a secluded cave beneath the southern falls, the dwarf Hervdana Saegrund greets travelers braving the wilderness.

The journey to understand water begins with a simple lesson on its dual nature: water embodies rebirth, carving stone and cleansing impurities when pure, but threatening ruin when tainted. Initiates seeking communion are sent into the wild to obtain a water sapta from those who dwell beside the element.

Deep in the damp marshes of the Wetlands, Hervdana Saegrund and her family make their home in a cave hidden directly beneath the southern waterfalls. Far removed from the protection of Ironforge guards, they endure the threat of Dark Iron dwarves lurking in the surrounding swamps to maintain their isolated life by the rushing falls.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If there's one truth ye need to learn about water, it's this: water means rebirth. It carves stone, cleanses filth, and heals the weary -- but only when it's pure. Taint it, and it'll ruin all it touches.
If ye seek the water sapta, find Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands. Her family dwells in a cave beneath the southern falls.
Go on then, don't let the river outrun ye.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Aye, I see it in yer eyes, dwarf. You're wonderin' what kind o' soul chooses to live out here, deep in the Wetlands, with Dark Iron scum lurkin' about and nary a guard in sight. Well, we all have our reasons, love.
But the real question is, what brings you to our home? Out here at the edge of the falls, I reckon we both know the answer to that.
Hervdana stretches out her arm, fingers catching mist spray from the waterfall.
